newsitem.title: INDIA: India Century rises 6 pct on bonus hopes.
newsitem.headline: India Century rises 6 pct on bonus hopes.

text.p: Shares of Century Textiles and Industries Ltd rose six percent in early trade on Tuesday after rising nearly 10 percent on Monday after the company said it will consider a bonus equity issue, brokers said.
The company said on Monday its board will also finalise accounts and recommend dividend for the year ended March 31, 1997 at the same meeting on May 6.
The board will also consider a ten-for-one stock split, which envisages sub-dividing the 100-rupee face value stock into 10-rupee shares, the firm had said.
The share jumped 137.25 rupees, or six percent, to 2,419.50 on the Bombay Stock Exchange.
On the National exchange, the share was up 109.80 rupees, or 5.0 percent, to 2,304.90.
